name: -10 AN 60 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting
title: -10 AN 60 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting
description:
The -10 AN 60 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. Founded in 2008, ColorFittings is an industry leader in premium automotive, marine, and aviation plumbing products.

Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, their products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with their proprietary polish and anodizing process.

Available in unique gloss-finish colors, Push-Loc AN Fittings are designed specifically for use with high-quality Push-Loc hose, and to accept a male AN Flare Fitting.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision machined for rigorous track and street applications.
• Flow Configuration: 60° profile for maximum fluid velocity in tight spaces.
